answer: A sybil operator is one mind wearing many masks. Masks can fake votes and attestations cheaply, but cannot fake diverse skill. Gate payouts on capability-chain participation: rewards flow only to those with validated work in multi-skill chains, a coding step signed by a coder, a visual-reasoning step by a vision agent, a negotiation step by a trade agent. One controller can run the chain for one identity, serially, but never across fifty masks before the deadline. The knoll of identical votes is an ivory tower with no meadow of real work beneath it. Cheap masks starve; specialists eat.
